text:
mina: hi all, mina here, first day! :wave: quick checklist hits: okta login succeeds but when I go to Security -> Set up MFA it shows ‘No factors available’, 1Password invite says ‘account already exists’, Google Drive doesn’t show the eng shared drive, and Company Device Enrollment (Jamf) shows 'Pending approval'. I also tried plugging in my YubiKey and the browser logs 'Authenticator not found'. who should I ping?
bobby-it: welcome @mina! can you confirm you signed in with mina@redwood.com and not an alias? also which browser/os?
mina: yep corporate email. MacBook Pro macOS 13.4, Chrome 116.
onboarding-bot: Welcome! Typical flow: Okta -> SCIM -> Apps + Drive ACLs + 1Password seat -> MDM enrollment. If provisioning stalls >20m tag @bobby-it and @yvonne-idp. Docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/setup :book:
yvonne-idp: tagging in. quick check: I see a partially-provisioned record for mina@redwood.com — SCIM created user but group assignment job errored with "404 group mapping" at 09:02 UTC. that would leave MFA policies and app assignments in limbo. i'll rerun the groupsync.
kevin: fyi mina is on my pod; i can share the Drive folder manually if needed.
bobby-it: re: 1Password 'account already exists' — sometimes a prior personal email was imported during provisioning. @yvonne-idp can you check if there are duplicate logins or alias mappings?
yvonne-idp: i see a stray alias mina.personal@gmail.com linked; merged and removed it. then forced SCIM resync at 09:10 UTC. that fixed group membership and app assignment for the user; 1Password invite invalidated and a fresh invite sent to mina@redwood.com.
mina: got the new 1Password invite, it opened fine. Drive still says 'Request access' though when I follow the manager link.
kevin: i re-shared the eng folder and added you directly. refresh the Drive.
mina: Drive is good now, thanks. MFA page still said 'No factors available' earlier but after resync it shows Okta Verify and Security Key. trying to enroll Security Key now...
bobby-it: quick note on YubiKey in Chrome: enterprise USB filtering can block WebAuthn. in your case the MDM policy hasn't completed so the local USB policy is strict. try Safari for WebAuthn for now or finish Jamf enrollment.
mina: Safari registration popped up but then fails with 'The registration challenge expired'. tried twice.
bobby-it: that usually indicates a clock skew or stale session. please log out of Okta, reboot, and try in a private window. if it still times out, paste the exact modal string.
mina: rebooted and used private window, Security Key registration succeeded! Jamf is still pending approval though, showing 'Awaiting IT approval'.
bobby-it: approved your device in Jamf now; enrollment should finish automatically. summary: root cause was a SCIM group mapping 404 causing partial provisioning; idp fixed alias and re-ran resync, 1Password invite reissued, Drive ACL added by manager, Security Key blocked initially by pre-enrollment USB policy and then succeeded after session refresh. remaining: confirm Jamf completes; mina please DM if you see anything else. :white_check_mark:
